mappings.mapping: Shape has input/output and cacheRead/cacheWrite defaulting to zero; shape alone does not establish input inclusion. addTokenUsage is fieldwise only.
mappings.limitation: Do not normalize unknown sources through this schema: absence would be lost. New module preserves null/absent instead.

mappings.mapping: input=max(0,prompt_tokens-cached_tokens); cacheRead=prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens; cacheWrite=0; output=completion_tokens. Full mapped prompt=input+cacheRead; mapped cacheWrite adds zero.
mappings.limitation: Missing upstream counters default to 0 and input subtraction is clamped. These mapped fields cannot recover upstream missingness/inconsistency. cacheWrite=0 is not proof of no upstream writes. Gateway compliance is not verified by local mapping or by these archived results.

mappings.mapping: input=max(0,prompt_tokens-cached_tokens); cacheRead=cached_tokens; cacheWrite=0; output=completion_tokens. usage.cost is separately reported when present.
mappings.limitation: The adapter does not preserve a separate upstream cache_write_tokens counter. Do not append such a counter to its mapped input without re-establishing overlap semantics. Upstream absence/clamping limitations are shared with openai-compatible.

mappings.mapping: input=input_tokens; cacheRead=cache_read_input_tokens; cacheWrite=cache_creation_input_tokens; output=output_tokens. Official Claude contract defines total input as the three disjoint input counters summed.
mappings.limitation: Cache counters default to zero in the adapter. The official Claude contract is not proof that a custom Anthropic-compatible gateway complies; use unknown without suitable source evidence. No Anthropic call was made for AG or AB clarification.

mappings.mapping: input_tokens is full input; cached_input_tokens is a subset. output_tokens already contains reasoning_output_tokens. Stored total_tokens equals input_tokens+output_tokens for each of the four author aggregates.
mappings.limitation: Author cacheWrite and provider-call count are unreported; author-process count is not provider-call count. Human time, preparation/modification split, actualUSD and development-agent costs remain unknown.

mappings.source: authorization telemetry and old optimization cost accounting
mappings.mapping: Authorization telemetry stores fieldwise knownTokens and unknown-call counts; actual USD totals become null when any cost is missing. Existing AOT cost accounting preserves measured/missing fields and separately sums input/output versus caches.
mappings.limitation: Neither aggregate shape defines input overlap on its own. The AOT production/quality/human ledger is not reused to fabricate unrelated measurements.

adapterCoverage: The registry creates openai-compatible, openrouter and anthropic adapters. Thin transport/logging wrappers do not establish an additional token partition. Only the AB mapped route and archived author account are used for this clarification.
officialDocumentationUse: Checked only provider-owned documentation for external field semantics. No pricing lookup, credential read or provider probe.
